verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph change notifications alert applications when OneDrive resources are created, updated or deleted. Delta queries let apps track changes to a driveItem over time. Together these give event triggers, but the user must build and host their own app to turn those events into actions; the evidence shows no built-in way to define rules. Missing for 10: a native rule or automation builder (condition → action), documented built-in actions triggered by events, and independent or hands-on evidence of event-driven automation in practice.
